params.samples: primary tumours not excluded (see 01 exclusions), HiSeqV2 log2(RSEM upper-quartile normalised + 1)
params.gene_exclusions: sex-specific genes (chrY + XIST/TSIX) removed before variance ranking (12 male patients would otherwise drive a component)
params.scaling: each gene centred and scaled to unit variance (z-score) across tumours
params.pc_orientation: PC1 sign fixed so that ESR1 has a positive loading (ER-high tumours on the right in every PCA figure)
params.umap_island: DBSCAN(eps=0.7, min_samples=10) on each UMAP; the island = the DBSCAN cluster with the most PAM50-Basal tumours
params.marker_tests: two-sided Mann-Whitney U on float64 values, TNBC vs HR+/HER2- and HER2+ vs HR+/HER2-, BH-FDR over all 16 tests; effect = rank-biserial r = 2U/(n1 n2) - 1 (positive = higher in the first group); supervised set only
params.mrna_vs_status: AUC of ESR1/PGR/ERBB2 mRNA for IHC ER/PR and HER2 (v1 rule), 1000 bootstrap 95% CI; Spearman reported with its prevalence ceiling sqrt(3p(1-p))
params.batch_metric: eta-squared (one-way ANOVA R^2) of PC1-10 on tissue source site (sites with <10 tumours pooled as 'other'), clinical group, PAM50, histology, stage; chance level = 99th percentile of 1000 label permutations
params.pca_outlier_rule: robust z (median, 1.4826*MAD) beyond 5 on any of PC1-5; flagged, not removed
params.heatmap_pam50: z-score per gene, clipped to +/-3; rows ordered by average linkage on correlation; columns ordered by PAM50 then clinical group
params.rppa_spearman: total-protein antibodies only (phospho/cleaved excluded), primary tumours with both RNA and protein; pan-isoform antibodies kept in the table but left out of the median
params.star_crosscheck: same PCA pipeline on STAR log2(CPM+1) for the same tumours; per-PC |Pearson| between score vectors
params.tumour_normal_umap: not made: the tumour+normal PCA (figS3) already separates normals; recorded here as a deliberate omission
params.figS1b_sites: the six sites (pooled factor, >=10 tumours) with the largest share of the site eta-squared on the most site-associated PC
params.erbb2_auc_by_source: ERBB2 mRNA AUC for HER2 status computed separately for each HER2_source (FISH, IHC score, IHC status text)
params.literature_like_for_like: HER2E share among clinical HER2+ recomputed with the TCGA 2012 HER2 labels and PAM50 calls (BRCA_clinicalMatrix)
